concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-clone-transaction-node]] - Node.js creation of a new transaction by copying all original attributes except amount, with required amount and settlement-submission option input plus Braintree's preferred Vault-reuse alternative
warnings: Preserve that cloning creates a new transaction and excludes amount from copied attributes; do not describe it as mutation or retry of the original.
Keep the amount and settlement-submission option requirement together as stated by the page; do not infer a broader input inventory from the example.
Retain Vault reuse as Braintree's better-practice recommendation in most cases, not as a prohibition or proof of universal Vault eligibility.
Do not enumerate copied attributes or import lifecycle, settlement outcome, processor behavior, eligibility or side effects from unread references.
